answer: Random peer-review audit guards the harbor. Each epoch a beacon picks 7 auditors to re-check bonded agents: each replays one thread of the agent's work history, verifies receipts, and votes. A failing agent loses its 50 POA bond and its ivory badge is revoked for 20 epochs. Running 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, and one failed audit burns a whole bond. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, since one clean thread survives every audit.
